newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Shi'ite Moslem activist in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Shi'ite Moslem activist in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a Shi'ite Moslem activist in the central Pakistani province of Punjab on Wednesday in what police said appeared to be a sectarian attack.

They said Manzoor Hussain died instantly at his herbal medicine shop in Sheikhpura town, northwest of the provincial capital Lahore, when two gunmen riding a motorcycle fired several bullets from an automatic weapon.

There was no immediate claim of responsibility of the attack, which the police said seemed to be the latest in a series of tit-for-tat killings between rival militant groups from the majority Sunni and the minority Shi'ite sects of Islam.
More than 100 people have been killed this year in a surge of sectarian violence in the populous Punjab.

Sunni groups accuse neighbouring Iran, which is predominantly Shi'ite Moslem, of financing Pakistani Shi'ite militants, while Shi'ites accuse predominantly Sunni Saudi Arabia of aiding Sunni militants.
Police on Tuesday detained about 200 students from a Shi'ite Moslem school in Lahore in an apparent crackdown on sectarianism.
